title: Midas in Manasses his time
summary: Raleigh names Midas in Manasses his time in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Midas, who in the raigne of Manasses held the Kingdome of Phrygia, and of whom the Poets fained Asses eares and the gift of Bacchus. He is not the Midas who was contemporary with Barac and Debora. The one-word title would fold onto midas, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
